executionMode.description: How the run was executed. Set by /atlas:test-flow, /atlas:test-all, /atlas:test-domain. 'parallel-subagents' indicates spawned obd-executor wave; 'sequential-fallback' indicates inline single-thread execution when subagent-spawn was unavailable.

children.description: Sub-runs aggregated into this parent record. V1 (/atlas:test-all batch) emitted an object keyed by sub-run-kind (e.g. {'test-flow': {...}, 'test-domain': {...}}). V2 (current) emits an array of objects. Accept both.

skipped.description: Optional: count of scenarios that were skipped (capability unavailable, gated, etc.). Distinct from blocked.

summary.description: Optional: one-line free-form summary of the run.

notes.description: Optional: free-form notes about the run (deviations, environment particulars, etc.).
